nodes.description: address governance storage variable holding privileged minter address, assigned from tx.origin in constructor
ERC20/TekkenFinance constructor that sets name, symbol, decimals, cap and governance = tx.origin
public function that requires msg.sender == governance and then calls _mint, allowing privileged minting
internal function performing external callback IERC1363Receiver.onTransferReceived on recipient after token transfer
public function transferring tokens then invoking _checkAndCallTransfer on the recipient contract
tx.origin used to initialize governance in constructor, vulnerable to phishing/access control bypass
msg.sender used in the governance comparison inside transferFromAndCall
external call to IERC1363Receiver.onTransferReceived executed before state finalization, enabling reentrancy
_mint invoked in transferFromAndCall guarded only by msg.sender == governance derived from tx.origin
fromAddress parameter of transferFromAndCall, recipient of freshly minted tokens
SubstractedValue parameter of transferFromAndCall, amount of tokens minted

edges.reason: governance is initialized directly from tx.origin, making the privileged role dependent on an untrusted origin that can be spoofed via phishing contracts
constructor writes tx.origin into governance, establishing tx.origin based authorization
constructor control flow sets the governance state variable that later gates minting
transferFromAndCall reads governance to authorize the minting operation
msg.sender is compared against governance inside transferFromAndCall, so authorization depends on an untrusted caller identity
transferFromAndCall passes user-controlled fromAddress and SubstractedValue into _mint after the weak governance check, allowing unauthorized minting
transferAndCallData transfers tokens and then calls into _checkAndCallTransfer, which performs an external callback
_checkAndCallTransfer invokes the recipient contract callback onTransferReceived after balances are moved, exposing the contract to reentrancy
the external onTransferReceived callback can re-enter transferAndCallData or other token functions before the original call finishes
_msgSender passed as the operator argument into the external callback is untrusted and can be leveraged during reentrant calls
fromAddress parameter supplies the mint recipient for transferFromAndCall
SubstractedValue parameter is the minted amount processed by _mint and SafeMath addition

normalization_plan.reason: fromAddress is a parameter whose only use is as the mint recipient inside transferFromAndCall, so it is collapsed into that core function node
SubstractedValue is a parameter consumed by the _mint call within transferFromAndCall, so it is merged into that core function node
